comments_site: No fish habitat - seasonal stream, isolated from Fraser R. by an impassable to fish cascades in R1. Channel is deeply scoured d/s of the lake and is barely defined u/s with numerous overland flow sections. Stream was crossed in R5 and R6 - all dry; tributary CHA126  in R1 was dry as well and has no well defined channel. Small open water wetland 00631COTR on the north side of R3 is isolated and has no connecting channel to R3. The lake 00641COTR is does not contain any fish and there are no other lakes and open water wetlands capable to support sport fish in the watershed. The entire watrshed is NFB above an impassable to fish R1.
